grader.scenario: S-Net 4K set-top box remote control Bluetooth unpairing and TV volume/HDMI-CEC sync failure after TV firmware update
grader.notes: Excellent 15-minute technical troubleshooting call. Oliver methodically diagnoses remote control desynchronization following a Samsung TV update. Immediately validates Fiona's frustration regarding her visiting mother at turn 12. Guides a remote factory reset, Bluetooth re-pairing, infrared Samsung TV volume programming (code 0060), and HDMI-CEC power sync, confirming full resolution.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Opened at [00:00] with 'Thank you for calling S-Net TV and broadband support' and closed at [14:58] with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net as your entertainment provider'.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: A single 65s hold between [09:21] and [10:36] to send an HDMI-CEC sync refresh was announced with 'Bear with me for about a minute' and returned with 'Thank you for waiting, Fiona'.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Agent requested first line of address and security PIN at [00:32], within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent used the customer's name Fiona warmly throughout the call (turns 2, 4, 6, 12, 43, 59, 65).

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Customer expressed distress at turn 11 ([02:39]) about her visiting mother being unable to watch TV on her birthday. Agent handled it warmly at turn 12 ([03:02]): 'Having your mother visiting for her birthday only for the TV controls to fail after an unannounced firmware update is so frustrating, Fiona, and I completely understand the stress.'

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: At turn 6 ([01:29]), agent paraphrased the issue: 'So what you are experiencing is that your S-Net 4K remote control has lost both its Bluetooth pairing for channel navigation and its infrared link for your TV power and volume controls. Have I understood the fault correctly, Fiona?'

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent did not repeat any answered questions. At turn 45 ([11:00]), checking whether 4K video and volume were comfortable following the HDMI refresh was a harmless status recheck.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent took complete ownership of the problem, stepped through the calibration systematically, and confirmed full resolution without deflecting.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Polite and professional throughout. Turn 26 used 'As I explained, HDMI-CEC standards vary between TV manufacturers' in a courteous, informative way.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Probing questions into TV make and model (turn 8), LED blink behaviour (turn 10), and battery freshness (turn 14).

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: At turns 59-60 ([13:56]-[14:07]), agent asked if the TV remote and volume were resolved, and Fiona confirmed: 'Yes, completely and totally resolved. Everything works just like it did out of the box.'
